links.comparator_used: Same models (GPT-5 Thinking, Gemini 2.5 Pro) in standard mode with live web search, without the agentic Deep Research mode
links.outcome: Citation integrity (relevance, accuracy, existence, source quality); guideline concordance was also assessed
links.effect: GPT-5 Thinking citation integrity 96.8% (231/239) rose to 100% (176/176) with Deep Research. Gemini 2.5 Pro rose from 64.6% (173/268) to 98.6% (274/278). Concordance with guidelines was similar across configurations: ACL 100% for all, RC 96.8-100%.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro showed substantially lower baseline performance (64.6% [173/268]; 95% CI: 58.5%-70.3%) but improved to 98.6% (274/278; 95% CI: 96.4%-99.6%) with Deep Research.

design_hint: retrieval grounding via live web search/deep research
